title: Crysis
shortDescription: Crytek's monumental graphical and sandbox physics tour-de-force, immortalized by the iconic PC gaming benchmark phrase 'Can It Run Crysis?'.
historicalSignificance: Pushed 3D PC graphics hardware so far ahead of its era that consumer graphics cards could not run it at maximum settings for nearly a decade, pioneering real-time volumetric sun rays, procedural foliage destructibility, and open-ended tactical nanosuit warfare.

editorialContent.overview: Set on the tropical Lingshan Islands in 2020, Delta Force operative Nomad is dispatched in a high-tech military Nanosuit to investigate an extraterrestrial archaeological discovery before an alien invasion flash-freezes the island.
editorialContent.gameplay: Dynamic tactical sandbox combat powered by four distinct Nanosuit modes: Maximum Armor (bullet resistance), Maximum Speed (sprinting over water), Maximum Strength (leaping onto rooftops and throwing vehicles), and Cloak (active optical camouflage).
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: CryEngine 2 introduced screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO), real-time soft shadows, parallax occlusion mapping, fully destructible jungle environments where trees snap under gunfire, and volumetric god-rays.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Became an indelible cultural meme ('Can it run Crysis?') that defined PC hardware benchmarking and technical prestige for over fifteen years.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PC DVD-ROM and remastered for modern systems with ray tracing.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 3 million copies sold on PC
awards: Best PC Game E3 2007 Game Critics Awards
PC Gamer Game of the Year

technicalSpecs.resolution: Scalable DirectX 10 3D resolution with real-time physics
technicalSpecs.soundChip: DirectSound 3D with Inon Zur orchestral score
